title: Grade 2 Math — Tue, Jun 02
description: 3D Solid Shapes — Day 2 of 5: Faces, edges and corners
subject: mathematics

questions.question: How many flat faces does a cube have?
questions.explanation: A cube has 6 square faces — top, bottom and four sides.

questions.question: A flat surface of a solid shape is called its ___.
questions.explanation: The flat parts you can touch are called faces.

questions.question: Where two faces meet, we get a line called an ___.
questions.explanation: The line where two faces meet is an edge.

questions.question: The pointy spot where edges meet is called a ___ (corner).
questions.explanation: A corner of a solid is called a vertex.

questions.question: How many corners (vertices) does a cube have?
How many faces does a cuboid (box) have?
questions.explanation: Like a cube, a cuboid also has 6 faces, but they are rectangles.

questions.question: A sphere has how many flat faces?
questions.explanation: A sphere is curved all over — it has 0 flat faces.

questions.question: How many flat faces does a cylinder have?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has 2 flat round faces — the top and the bottom.

questions.question: How many edges does a cube have?
A cone has how many flat faces?
questions.explanation: A cone has 1 flat round face at the bottom and a curved surface.

questions.question: How many corners (vertices) does a cone have?
questions.explanation: A cone has 1 vertex — the sharp tip at the top.

questions.question: Which solid has 6 faces that are all squares?
questions.explanation: All 6 faces of a cube are equal squares.

questions.question: How many corners does a sphere have?
questions.explanation: A sphere is smooth and round — it has no corners.

questions.question: The faces of a cuboid are shaped like ___.
questions.explanation: A cuboid's flat faces are rectangles.

questions.question: Which solid has a curved surface AND two flat circles?
questions.explanation: A cylinder has a curved side and two flat round faces.
